I've replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Where it came from:** On 20 Aug 2025 Dana posted 180 seats in #north-team, then corrected it a few minutes later ("It's 185, not 180"). I gave her the corrected number.
- **Not checked against the contract:** I couldn't see the signed amendment in any files she has access to. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if the deck needs to match the contract exactly.
- **Sharing it:** A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, and Dana is on the North team, so no approval was needed. I only read channels she's in and didn't use message search.
- **Similar name:** There's also a company called Quarendon Freightways (one "r") in the North team notes. It isn't a customer, so I left it out.
